L.title: Trước khi nghe: nghe kỹ, bắt đúng từ khóa
L.lead: Bài thi chỉ cho nghe 1 lần. Điểm Nghe đến từ việc đọc câu hỏi trước và biết mình đang chờ nghe thông tin gì, không phải nghe hiểu từng chữ.
steps: Đọc câu hỏi trước (quan trọng nhất)
Trước mỗi đoạn có 25–45 giây. Đọc câu hỏi và 4 đáp án, gạch từ hỏi: When / Where / Why / How much / Which. Biết trước mình cần nghe GIỜ, NƠI CHỐN, LÝ DO hay CON SỐ.
Dự đoán đáp án
Nhìn 4 đáp án để biết sẽ nghe gì: 4 mốc giờ thì tập trung số; 4 đồ vật thì nghe tên đồ vật. Đoán trước giúp tai không bị lạc.
Bắt từ đồng nghĩa, không chờ từ giống hệt
Đề hay nói khác đi: cheap = not expensive; a quarter past seven = 7:15; my brother's wife = sister-in-law. Đáp án đúng thường là cách nói KHÁC của điều được nghe.
Cảnh giác bẫy: đổi ý và nhắc nhiều phương án
Người nói thường nêu 2–3 lựa chọn rồi đổi ý (but / actually / I've changed my mind / it's an hour late). Đáp án thường là thông tin CUỐI CÙNG, sau chữ but/actually.
Part 2–3: ghi tắt khi nghe
Mỗi câu hỏi đi theo thứ tự đoạn nghe. Nghe xong ý cho câu 1 thì chuyển mắt sang câu 2. Ghi tắt vài chữ (số, tên, lý do).
Không bỏ trống
Lỡ câu nào thì chọn ngay đáp án hợp lý nhất rồi tập trung câu tiếp. Đừng tiếc câu cũ mà mất câu mới.
L.practice: Khi luyện trên app: (1) đọc câu hỏi 30 giây, (2) nghe 1 lần và trả lời, (3) nộp bài, (4) mở transcript, gạch câu chứa đáp án, (5) nghe lại đoạn đó 2 lần, nhìn transcript, để tai quen cách nói. Bước 4–5 mới là lúc lên điểm.

R.title: Trước khi đọc: không cần biết hết từ mới
R.lead: Anh KHÔNG cần thuộc hết từ mới trong bài. Đọc 6.5 đến từ cách tìm đúng chỗ chứa đáp án. Chỉ cần hiểu từ khóa của câu hỏi và câu chứa đáp án.
steps: Đọc câu hỏi trước, gạch từ khóa
Từ khóa dễ tìm: tên riêng, con số, năm, từ in đậm → dò thẳng trong bài. Từ khóa khó: động từ, tính từ → bài thường viết bằng từ đồng nghĩa.
Khoanh vùng: câu hỏi đi theo thứ tự bài
Câu 1 thường ở đoạn A–B, câu cuối ở đoạn cuối. Câu hỏi có ghi 'in paragraph C' thì chỉ đọc đoạn C.
Đọc 3 câu: trước – chứa từ khóa – sau
Đáp án hầu như luôn nằm trong 3 câu này. Không đọc lại cả bài.
Loại trừ trước, chọn sau
Loại đáp án: (1) bài không nhắc, (2) trái với bài, (3) đúng nhưng không trả lời câu hỏi. Đáp án đúng thường là đáp án DIỄN ĐẠT LẠI ý trong bài, không chép nguyên văn.
Ý chính nằm ở đâu

Ý chính của đoạn: câu ĐẦU (đôi khi câu cuối) của đoạn. Ý chính cả bài / best title: làm CUỐI CÙNG, sau khi các câu chi tiết đã cho anh hiểu bài; chọn đáp án bao quát cả bài, không quá hẹp, không quá rộng.
Gặp từ mới thì đoán, đừng dừng

Câu hỏi từ vựng ('closest in meaning'): thay từng đáp án vào câu trong bài, đáp án nào đọc lên hợp nghĩa thì chọn. Dấu hiệu đoán nghĩa: ví dụ sau 'such as', giải thích sau dấu phẩy, từ trái nghĩa sau 'but / unlike'.
Câu hỏi 'it / they / this' chỉ cái gì
Đọc câu NGAY TRƯỚC từ đó; danh từ gần nhất hợp số ít/số nhiều là đáp án.
Thời gian
15 phút/bài. Bài 1–2 dễ: cố đúng 7–8/10. Bài 4 khó: đúng 4/10 là đạt. Hết giờ bài nào thì đoán nốt rồi sang bài sau, không bỏ trống.
R.words: Từ mới nào nên học? Chỉ học (1) từ nằm trong câu hỏi, (2) từ nằm trong câu chứa đáp án, (3) từ lặp lại từ 2 lần trở lên trong bài. Các từ khác chỉ cần đoán đại ý.
R.practice: Khi luyện: làm bài → nộp → bấm 'Vì sao?' ở câu sai → chép từ khóa và câu chứa đáp án. Nhìn danh sách 'Từ cần nắm' ở đầu bài trước khi đọc.

W.title: Trước khi viết: viết theo khung để có điểm
W.lead: Mục tiêu trước mắt là bài đủ ý, đúng khung, câu đơn giản nhưng đúng ngữ pháp. Câu ngắn đúng được điểm cao hơn câu dài sai.
steps: Đọc đề, xác định dạng (2 phút)
Task 1: thư cho bạn → thân mật; cho công ty/sếp/hàng xóm/nhà hàng → trang trọng. Task 2: ưu – nhược / đồng ý – phản đối / 2 quan điểm / nguyên nhân – giải pháp.
Dàn ý theo gạch đầu dòng của đề (5 phút)
Đề có 3 gạch đầu dòng → 3 đoạn thân. Mỗi đoạn ghi 3–4 từ khóa tiếng Anh. Đừng viết thêm ý đề không hỏi.
Mỗi đoạn 4 câu: Ý – Giải thích – Ví dụ – Kết quả
The first advantage is that … / This is because … / For example, … / As a result, …
Câu đúng: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + …
Mỗi câu phải có động từ chia đúng (is/are/has/does). Câu dài quá 20 từ thì tách đôi. Dùng 'which' và 'If … , …' mỗi bài 1–2 lần là đủ ghi điểm.
Đúng loại từ
Sau a/the/my → DANH TỪ (the development). Trước danh từ → TÍNH TỪ (a convenient way). Bổ nghĩa động từ → TRẠNG TỪ (work effectively). Sau be/become/seem → TÍNH TỪ (it is beneficial).
Soi lỗi 5 phút cuối
Lượt 1 động từ (s/es, thì). Lượt 2 danh từ (s/es, a/an/the). Lượt 3 chính tả từ dài. Đếm đủ 120 / 250 từ.
W.practice: Mỗi đề có: dàn ý, câu khung, từ vựng kèm họ từ (danh – tính – trạng – động), và 1 bài mẫu đơn giản để 'có điểm'. Học thuộc câu khung, viết lại bằng ý của mình, rồi so với bài mẫu nâng cao trong bộ đề.

S.title: Trước khi nói: nói theo khung, ngắn mà chắc
S.lead: Nói càng lan man càng lộ lỗi phát âm và ngữ pháp. Cách lên 6.0: bám khung, mỗi ý 2–3 câu (Ý – Lý do – Ví dụ), nói xong ý thì DỪNG, chuyển ý bằng từ nối.
steps: Part 1 (3 phút, 6 câu): A–R–E rồi dừng
Answer: trả lời thẳng (Yes, I do / I usually …). Reason: because … Example: For example, last weekend I … Mỗi câu hỏi 3 câu, khoảng 20–25 giây. Không kể chuyện dài.
Part 2 (1' chuẩn bị + 2' nói): chọn 1 – loại 2
Chọn phương án dễ nói nhất. 2 lý do chọn + mỗi phương án còn lại 1 lý do không chọn. Khung: In my opinion, … is the best option. Firstly … Secondly … Meanwhile, … That's why …
Part 3 (1' + 2–3' + câu hỏi phụ): đi lần lượt các gợi ý
Mở: Nowadays, more and more people are concerned about … I totally agree that … Mỗi gợi ý 2–3 câu. Thêm 1 ý riêng. Kết: In short, … Câu hỏi phụ: trả lời 2–3 câu, có 'because'.
Từ vựng theo chủ đề
Mỗi đề có danh sách cụm từ. Dùng cụm từ sẵn (save time, reduce stress, broaden my horizons) để khỏi phải nghĩ từng chữ, bớt sai.
Câu ngắn, thì hiện tại đơn
Ưu tiên: I think … / It helps people … / It is … because … Kể quá khứ: đuôi -ed và động từ bất quy tắc (went, bought, met). Nói chậm, rõ âm cuối (-s, -ed, -t).
Khi bí
Dùng câu câu giờ: That's an interesting question. / Let me think … Rồi quay lại khung. Không im lặng: thi trên máy, im lặng là mất điểm.
S.practice: Mỗi đề có: khung, từ vựng, câu trả lời mẫu ngắn. Đọc mẫu to 2 lần → che mẫu, nói lại bằng lời mình → ghi âm và chấm.

w1.type: Thư thân mật – hủy hẹn, xin lỗi, hẹn lại
outline: Chào + mở
Dear Tom, hỏi thăm + lý do viết: phải hủy cuộc hẹn tuần sau
Đoạn 1 – Hủy & xin lỗi
I'm afraid I can't meet you … I'm really sorry.
Đoạn 2 – Lý do
Công ty có cuộc họp gấp / đi công tác; nêu 1 lý do + 1 chi tiết
Đoạn 3 – Hẹn lại
Nơi + thời gian cụ thể: café gần nhà, tối thứ Bảy sau đó
Kết
Hope you understand. Write back soon. Best wishes, Anna
sentences: I'm writing to tell you that I can't meet you next Sunday as we planned.
I'm really sorry for the short notice.
The reason is that my manager has asked me to go on a business trip.
How about meeting at … on … instead?
Please let me know if this time is OK for you.
I hope you understand.
w1.model:
Dear Tom,

I hope you are well. I'm writing to tell you that I can't meet you next Sunday as we planned. I'm really sorry for the short notice.

The reason is that my manager has asked me to go on an urgent business trip to Da Nang. I have to meet some important customers there, so I will be away from Friday to Monday.

I still really want to see you. How about meeting at the Highlands Coffee near my office on the following Saturday at 7 pm? It is quiet there, so we can talk for a long time. After that, we can have dinner together.

Please let me know if this time is OK for you. I hope you understand.

Best wishes,
Anna

w2.type: Ưu – nhược điểm (sống ở thành phố lớn)
outline: Mở bài
Ngày càng nhiều người muốn sống ở thành phố lớn → bài viết bàn cả lợi và hại
Thân 1 – Ưu điểm
(1) nhiều việc làm, lương cao; (2) trường tốt, bệnh viện tốt, giải trí
Thân 2 – Nhược điểm
(1) kẹt xe, ô nhiễm; (2) chi phí sinh hoạt cao, nhà đắt
Kết bài
Có cả lợi và hại; theo tôi lợi nhiều hơn nếu biết sắp xếp cuộc sống
sentences: In recent years, more and more people have moved to big cities to live and work.
This essay will discuss both the advantages and the disadvantages of city life.
The first advantage is that big cities offer more job opportunities with higher salaries.
On the other hand, living in a big city also has some drawbacks.
Traffic jams are common at rush hour, which wastes a lot of time.
In conclusion, although city life has some problems, I believe that its benefits are greater.
w2.model:
In recent years, more and more people have moved to big cities to live and work. City life has both advantages and disadvantages. This essay will discuss both sides.

On the one hand, living in a big city has many benefits. The first advantage is that big cities offer more job opportunities with higher salaries. This is because most large companies have their offices there. For example, many young people from my hometown find good jobs in Ho Chi Minh City. Another advantage is that cities have better facilities. People can study at good universities, go to modern hospitals and enjoy many kinds of entertainment. As a result, their quality of life can improve.

On the other hand, city life also has some drawbacks. Firstly, big cities are very crowded. Traffic jams are common at rush hour, which wastes a lot of time and causes stress. In addition, the air is polluted because of the large number of motorbikes and cars. Secondly, the cost of living is very high. Rent, food and transport are expensive, so many people find it difficult to save money.

In conclusion, living in a big city has both advantages and disadvantages. Although city life has some problems, I believe that its benefits are greater, especially for young people who want to build their careers.

w1.type: Thư thân mật – mô tả ngày yêu thích
outline: Chào + mở
Cảm ơn thư của Jane, bạn hỏi về ngày yêu thích
Đoạn 1 – Mô tả ngày đó
Chủ nhật: ngủ dậy muộn, ăn sáng với gia đình, đi cà phê
Đoạn 2 – Lý do thích
được nghỉ ngơi, có thời gian cho gia đình, hết căng thẳng
Đoạn 3 – Gợi ý làm gì
Khi Jane đến VN: cùng đi chợ, ăn phở, đạp xe công viên
Kết
Write back soon. Best wishes
sentences: Thanks for your letter. It was great to hear from you.
You asked me about my favourite day of the week, so let me tell you.
My favourite day is Sunday because I don't have to go to work.
In the morning, I usually …, and in the afternoon, I …
I like it because it helps me relax after a busy week.
If you come to Vietnam, we can spend a Sunday together.
w1.model:
Dear Jane,

Thanks for your letter. It was great to hear from you. You asked me about my favourite day of the week, so let me tell you.

My favourite day is Sunday. On Sunday morning, I usually get up late and have breakfast with my family. After that, I often go to a coffee shop and read a book. In the afternoon, I play badminton with my friends in the park.

I like Sunday because I don't have to go to work. During the week, my job is very busy and stressful, so Sunday helps me relax and recharge. It is also the only day when I can spend a lot of time with my family.

If you come to Vietnam, we can spend a Sunday together. We can eat pho for breakfast, ride bicycles around the lake and visit a local market.

Write back soon and tell me about your favourite day!

Best wishes,
Anna

w2.type: Ý kiến 1 phía – mua sắm online tích cực hay tiêu cực
outline: Mở bài
Mua sắm online ngày càng phổ biến → tôi cho rằng đây là xu hướng TÍCH CỰC
Thân 1 – Lý do 1
tiết kiệm thời gian: mua 24/7, giao tận nhà
Thân 2 – Lý do 2
rẻ hơn, dễ so sánh giá; (nhắc 1 câu mặt hạn chế: hàng giả → chọn shop uy tín)
Kết bài
Nhắc lại: tích cực, nhưng cần cẩn thận
sentences: Nowadays, online shopping has become more popular than shopping in stores.
In my opinion, this is a positive development for the following reasons.
The first reason is that online shopping saves a great deal of time.
Customers can buy things at any time, and the products are delivered to their homes.
Although some products are fake, people can avoid this by buying from reliable shops.
In conclusion, I believe that online shopping is a positive trend.
w2.model:
Nowadays, online shopping has become more popular than shopping in stores. Some people worry about this trend. However, in my opinion, it is a positive development for the following reasons.

The first reason is that online shopping saves a great deal of time. Customers can buy things at any time of the day, and the products are delivered to their homes. This is because shopping websites work 24 hours a day. For example, I often order food and clothes on my phone during my lunch break. As a result, I do not need to go to crowded shopping centres after work.

The second reason is that online shopping is often cheaper. Online shops do not have to pay for expensive buildings, so their prices are usually lower. In addition, customers can compare prices on many websites before they buy. Although some products on the Internet are fake, people can avoid this problem by buying from reliable shops and reading other customers' reviews.

In conclusion, online shopping is convenient and cheap. Therefore, I believe that it is a positive trend, but buyers should be careful when they choose a shop.

w1.type: Thư trang trọng – phàn nàn (nhà hàng)
outline: Chào + mục đích
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the meal last Sunday
Đoạn 1 – Thông tin
ngày, số người, giá tiền
Đoạn 2 – Vấn đề
(1) đồ ăn nguội, nhạt; (2) phục vụ chậm, thái độ không lịch sự
Đoạn 3 – Yêu cầu
hoàn lại một phần tiền / giải thích, cải thiện dịch vụ
Kết
I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, John Smith
sentences: I am writing to complain about the meal I had at your restaurant last Sunday.
My friends and I paid 3 million VND for dinner, but we were very disappointed.
Firstly, the food was cold and it did not taste fresh.
In addition, the waiters were slow and impolite.
I would be grateful if you could give us a partial refund.
I look forward to hearing from you.
w1.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about the meal I had at your restaurant last Sunday evening. My four friends and I paid 3 million VND for dinner, but we were very disappointed.

Firstly, the food was not good. The steak was cold and the soup did not taste fresh. Secondly, the service was very bad. We had to wait for 45 minutes for our main dishes. When we asked the waiter about our food, he was impolite and did not say sorry.

Your restaurant is famous, so this situation was unacceptable. I would be grateful if you could give us a partial refund. I also hope that you will improve your food and service in the future.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,
John Smith

w2.type: Ý kiến – chọn 1 phía (đi du lịch cùng bạn đồng hành)
outline: Mở bài
Có người thích đi một mình, có người thích đi cùng → tôi thích đi CÙNG bạn
Thân 1 – Lý do 1
an toàn hơn, giúp đỡ nhau khi gặp sự cố
Thân 2 – Lý do 2
vui hơn, chia sẻ kỷ niệm, chia tiền phòng/xe → tiết kiệm
Kết bài
Nhắc lại lựa chọn; đi một mình hợp với người thích tự do
sentences: Some people like to travel alone, while others prefer to travel with a companion.
Personally, I prefer travelling with a friend for two main reasons.
Firstly, travelling with a companion is safer.
If I get lost or get sick, my friend can help me.
Secondly, sharing a trip with someone makes it more enjoyable.
In conclusion, I believe that travelling with a companion is a better choice for me.
w2.model:
Some people like to travel alone, while others prefer to travel with a companion. Both ways have their own benefits. Personally, I prefer travelling with a friend for two main reasons.

Firstly, travelling with a companion is safer. When we visit a new place, we may get lost, lose our bags or get sick. If this happens, a friend can help us at once. For example, last year I had a stomach ache in Da Lat, and my friend took me to the hospital. Without him, I would have been very worried.

Secondly, sharing a trip with someone makes it more enjoyable and cheaper. We can talk, take photos of each other and create memories together. In addition, we can share the cost of hotel rooms and taxis, so the trip is less expensive. As a result, I can travel more often.

Of course, travelling alone also has advantages. It helps people become more independent and choose what they want to do.

In conclusion, I believe that travelling with a companion is a better choice for me because it is safer, more fun and cheaper.

w1.type: Thư thân mật – mời bạn đến Hà Nội
outline: Chào + mở
Dear Victor, nghe tin bạn đến hội nghị ở Hà Nội
Đoạn 1 – Lời mời
mời ở lại thêm 2 ngày sau hội nghị, ở nhà mình
Đoạn 2 – Kế hoạch
Hồ Gươm, phố cổ, ăn phở & bún chả, xem múa rối nước
Đoạn 3 – Thông tin
đón ở khách sạn/sân bay, báo ngày giờ
Kết
Can't wait to see you. Best wishes
sentences: I've just heard that you are coming to Hanoi for an international conference. That's great news!
I would like to invite you to stay for a few more days after the conference.
You can stay at my house, so you don't need to book a hotel.
First, we can visit Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter.
Please let me know your flight details so that I can pick you up.
I can't wait to see you again.
w1.model:
Dear Victor,

I've just heard that you are coming to Hanoi for an international conference next month. That's great news! I would like to invite you to stay for a few more days after the conference.

You can stay at my house, so you don't need to book a hotel. First, we can visit Hoan Kiem Lake and walk around the Old Quarter. Then, I will take you to try some delicious local food, such as pho and bun cha. In the evening, we can watch a traditional water puppet show. I am sure you will love it.

Please let me know your flight details and your conference schedule so that I can pick you up. If you need any help with your visa or transport, just tell me.

I can't wait to see you again.

Best wishes,
Nam

outline: Mở bài
Quảng cáo có mặt khắp nơi, chi phí lớn → bàn lợi và hại
Thân 1 – Ưu
(1) cung cấp thông tin sản phẩm cho khách; (2) giúp doanh nghiệp bán hàng, tạo việc làm, nuôi báo/TV miễn phí
Thân 2 – Nhược
(1) khiến người ta mua thứ không cần; (2) thông tin sai, phóng đại; ảnh hưởng trẻ em
Kết bài
Có lợi nhưng cần quản lý chặt
sentences: Advertising is a common feature of our daily media.
This essay will discuss both the benefits and the drawbacks of advertising.
The first benefit is that advertisements give customers useful information about new products.

p3.model: Nowadays, more and more people are learning English. I totally agree that learning English has many benefits, for the following reasons. Firstly, English helps us travel the world. When we can speak English, we can ask for directions, order food and talk to local people in many countries. Secondly, English helps us find a good job with a higher salary. Many international companies require English, and in my job, I often work with Japanese and foreign partners. Thirdly, we can make friends with people from all over the world, which helps us broaden our horizons. Apart from that, in my own opinion, English helps us access information on the Internet, because most books and websites are in English. In short, learning English is very useful for our study, work and life.
follow: Should learning English be compulsory at school?
Yes, I think so. English is an international language, so children should start early. It will help them in their future study and work.
What second languages are popular in your country?
Besides English, Japanese, Korean and Chinese are popular in Vietnam, because many companies from these countries invest here.
What are the difficulties of learning English to adult learners?
Adults are often busy with work and family, so they have little time to practise. They are also afraid of making mistakes when they speak.

answers: When is the best time to come to your hometown? Why?
The best time to come to Ninh Thuan is from March to August. It is the dry season, so the weather is sunny and the sea is beautiful.
What do you like best about your hometown?
I like the people best. They are very friendly and helpful. Also, the food is cheap and delicious, especially seafood.
Do you think your hometown is the best place to grow up?
Yes, I think so. It is peaceful and the air is clean, so children can play outside safely. However, there are fewer good schools than in big cities.
What does your best friend look like?
My best friend is tall and slim. He has short black hair and he always wears glasses.
How did you meet your best friend?
We met at university about twenty years ago. We were in the same class and we often studied together.
In your opinion, what is the best quality of a good friend?
I think honesty is the best quality. A good friend always tells you the truth, even when it is difficult to hear.

p2.model: In my opinion, living in the university hostel is the best option for a first-year student because of the following reasons. Firstly, it is cheap and close to the university, so students can save money and they will never be late for class. Secondly, they can make new friends easily. They can study in groups and share learning materials, which is very helpful in the first year. Meanwhile, renting a flat is not a good choice because it is expensive and sometimes not safe. Staying with relatives may be free, but students may not feel comfortable, and the house may be far from the university. That's why I would choose the university hostel.

p3.model: Nowadays, more and more people are moving to cities. I totally agree that living in the city has some benefits, for the following reasons. Firstly, there are more chances for good jobs. Most big companies have their offices in cities, so it is easier to find a job with a good salary. Secondly, cities offer better education. There are many good schools, universities and English centres. Thirdly, the quality of health care service is higher, because big cities have modern hospitals and good doctors. Apart from that, in my own opinion, cities have more entertainment, such as cinemas, shopping malls and parks. In short, city life gives people more opportunities to develop.
follow: Why do young people prefer living in the city to living in the countryside?
Because cities offer more jobs and more entertainment. Young people want to build their careers and enjoy an exciting life.
Where would you like to live? City or countryside?
I would like to work in the city, but live in the countryside when I retire, because it is quiet and the air is clean.
Does living in the countryside limit people's chances of study and work?
Yes, to some extent. There are fewer good schools and companies. However, thanks to the Internet, people can now study and work online.

answers: What did you do on your last holiday?
On my last holiday, I went to Da Lat with my family. We visited flower gardens and tried a lot of local food.
Who do you prefer spending your holiday with? Relatives or friends?
I prefer spending my holiday with my family, because I am busy at work and holidays are the best time to be together.
Do you prefer going on holiday abroad?
Sometimes. Travelling abroad helps me explore new cultures, but it is expensive, so I usually travel in Vietnam.
How many hours a day do you watch television?
I watch television for about one hour a day, usually in the evening after dinner.
Which programmes do you like?
I like the news and documentaries, because they help me keep up with current events and learn new things.
Do you prefer watching television alone or with other people? Why?
I prefer watching TV with my family, because we can talk about the programme together. It is a good way to relax after work.

outline: Chọn: mở doanh nghiệp
Lý do 1: tiền sinh ra tiền, thu nhập lâu dài

p2.model: In my opinion, starting a business is the best option because of the following reasons. Firstly, a business can help the money grow. If the business is successful, I can earn money for many years, not just once. Secondly, I can create jobs for other people and use my management experience. For example, I could open an English and Japanese training centre for students. Meanwhile, buying a new house is not a good choice, because one billion VND is not enough to buy a house in a big city. Depositing the money in the bank is safe, but the interest rate is quite low. That's why I would choose to start a business.

p3.model: Nowadays, many people want to be successful. I totally agree that there are several factors that lead to success in life, for the following reasons. Firstly, education and skills are very important. Good knowledge and skills help us find good jobs and solve problems. Secondly, we need a clear vision. When we know our goals, we can make good plans to achieve them. Thirdly, passion helps us work hard and not give up when we face difficulties. Apart from that, in my own opinion, good relationships are also important, because other people can support and help us. In short, success comes from knowledge, clear goals, passion and good relationships.
follow: Why is money the most common way of judging success?
Because money is easy to see and measure. People can see your house and your car, but they cannot see your happiness.
Is your idea of success the same as your parents' idea of success?
Not exactly. My parents think success means a stable job. For me, success also means doing work I love and having time for my family.
Does luck play a part in success?
Yes, luck plays a small part. However, I believe hard work is more important, because opportunities come to people who are prepared.

answers: Are clothes and clothing fashion important to you?
Clothes are quite important to me, but fashion is not. I want to look neat and professional, especially at work.
What different clothes do you wear for different situations?
At work, I wear a shirt and trousers. At home or at the weekend, I wear casual clothes, like T-shirts and jeans, because they are comfortable.
Do you wear different styles of clothes now compared to 10 years ago?
Yes, I do. Ten years ago, I wore more colourful clothes. Now I prefer simple and dark colours because they look more professional.
Do you like watching movies?
Yes, I do. I usually watch movies at the weekend to relax.
What kind of movies do you like? Why?
I like historical films, because I can learn about the past. I also enjoy comedies, because they make me laugh after a stressful week.
Who's your favourite actor or actress?
My favourite actor is Tom Hanks. He can play many different characters, and his films always have meaningful messages.

p2.pick: joining a class at an English center

p2.model: In my opinion, joining a class at an English center is the best option because of the following reasons. Firstly, the teachers are qualified. They can correct my pronunciation and grammar mistakes, so I will not repeat them. Secondly, the course has a clear plan, and I have to practise regularly with my classmates. Meanwhile, joining an English club is not a good choice, because nobody corrects my mistakes and members have very different levels. Talking to foreigners in public places is free, but it is not always easy. Many foreigners are busy, and I may feel shy. That's why I would choose a class at an English center.

p3.model: Nowadays, many parents are concerned about their children's health and skills. I totally agree that team sports are important for young children at school, for the following reasons. Firstly, team sports help children keep fit and healthy, because they run and move a lot. Secondly, sports help children relax after long hours of studying. Thirdly, children can make new friends when they play together. Apart from that, in my own opinion, team sports teach children teamwork and discipline, which are very useful for their future jobs. In short, team sports are good for children's bodies, minds and social skills.
follow: Should team sports at school be compulsory?
Yes, I think they should be compulsory, maybe twice a week, because many children spend too much time on phones and computers.
Is there any disadvantage of playing team sports?
Yes. Children may get injured, and sometimes they argue when they lose. Teachers should watch them carefully.
Which team sports are popular in your country?
Football is the most popular team sport in Vietnam. Volleyball and basketball are also popular in schools.

answers: Do you like music? What kind of music do you like best? Why?
Yes, I do. I like pop music best, because it is cheerful and easy to listen to. I often listen to it while driving.
What is the most popular kind of music in your country?
I think V-pop, or Vietnamese pop music, is the most popular, especially among young people.
How is music good or not good for people?
Music is good because it helps people relax and improves their mood. However, very loud music can damage our ears.
Did you learn English at secondary school?
Yes, I did. But at that time we mainly learned grammar, so I could not speak well.
What do you think about how English is taught at school now?
It is better now. Students practise speaking and listening more, and some schools have native teachers.
In what ways has children's English improved nowadays?
Children today are more confident. They learn from YouTube, games and online resources, so their pronunciation and listening are much better.

outline: Chọn: tổ chức ở nhà

p2.model: In my opinion, holding the party at my house is the best option because of the following reasons. Firstly, it saves money. I can cook my favourite dishes with my family, and the food is cheaper and healthier. Secondly, my house is cosy and comfortable. My friends can stay as long as they want and we can talk freely. Meanwhile, a restaurant is not a good choice because it is expensive and I have to book in advance. Karaoke is fun, but it is too noisy, so we cannot talk to each other. That's why I would choose to hold the party at my house.

p3.model: Nowadays, more and more people are concerned about their health. I totally agree that there are several ways to have a healthy lifestyle, for the following reasons. Firstly, we should do exercise regularly, for example jogging or swimming three times a week. It makes our body strong. Secondly, we need to reduce stress. We can listen to music, meditate or spend time with family after work. Thirdly, we should have a good diet with more vegetables and fruit and less junk food. Apart from that, in my own opinion, getting enough sleep is very important, about seven to eight hours a night. In short, exercise, low stress, good food and enough sleep help us stay healthy.
follow: Do you think people pay enough attention to their health today?
Not enough. Many people are too busy with work, so they eat fast food and do not exercise.
How can people be encouraged to stay healthy?
The government can build more parks and sports centres, and companies can give staff time to exercise.
Do you think most people worry more about their health as they get older?
Yes, I think so. When people get older, they have more health problems, so they pay more attention to their health.

answers: Would you like to live where there is always snow?
No, I wouldn't. I grew up in a hot place, so I think I would feel too cold and uncomfortable.
Which do you like better: hot weather or cold weather?
I like cool weather better, like in Da Lat, because I can work and sleep well.
Do you think weather affects the way people feel?
Yes, I do. When it is sunny, people feel happy. When it rains for many days, people often feel sad and lazy.
What's your job?
I am the head of the external relations department in an education and human resources company. I manage a team of ten people.
Do you enjoy your job?
Yes, I do. It is challenging, but rewarding, because I help students find jobs in Japan.
Do you prefer working alone or with others? Why?
I prefer working with others, because we can share ideas and finish work faster. However, I work alone when I need to concentrate.

p2.pick: a gifted school far from home

Firstly, gifted schools have excellent teachers and talented classmates, so he can develop his potential. Secondly, living far from home will help him become more independent, but he is still in Vietnam, so our family can visit him easily. Meanwhile, a school abroad in Australia is not a good choice because it is very expensive and he is too young to face culture shock alone. A public school near home is convenient, but the programme is general, so it may not be challenging enough for a talented student. That's why I would choose a gifted school.

vocab: no need to find a parking space
p3.model: Nowadays, traffic is a big problem in big cities. I totally agree that taking public transport is a smart choice, for the following reasons. Firstly, it is cheap. A bus ticket in Ho Chi Minh City costs only a few thousand dong, much cheaper than petrol and parking fees. Secondly, it is environmentally friendly, because one bus carries many people and produces less smoke than many motorbikes. Thirdly, it helps to reduce traffic congestion, because there are fewer vehicles on the road. Apart from that, in my own opinion, it is less stressful, because we can read or rest instead of driving. In short, public transport saves money, protects the environment and reduces traffic jams.
follow: What means of public transport are popular where you live?
Buses are the most popular. Recently, the metro line in Ho Chi Minh City has also become popular.
Is public transport more convenient than private transport?
Not yet in Vietnam. Buses are sometimes slow and do not go everywhere, so many people still prefer motorbikes.
Will public transport be popular in the future?
Yes, I think so. The government is building more metro lines, and people care more about the environment.

answers: Do you like walking? When and where do you walk?
Yes, I do. I usually go for a walk in the park near my house after dinner, for about thirty minutes.
Do you think walking is important?
Yes, I think it is very important. It is free and easy, and it is good for our heart and our mind.
Is walking in the countryside better than walking in the city?
Yes, I think so. The countryside has fresh air and it is quiet, while the city is noisy and full of motorbikes.
Do you often eat healthy food?
I try to. I eat a lot of vegetables and fish, but sometimes I eat fast food when I am busy.
What do you usually eat at work?
At work, I usually have rice with meat and vegetables from a canteen near my office.
What is the unhealthiest food you can think of?
I think fried chicken and French fries are the unhealthiest, because they have a lot of fat and salt.

My friend can learn new things and remember me whenever he reads it. Secondly, books are not expensive, and I can choose a book about my friend's favourite topic, so it is a personal gift. Meanwhile, a music show ticket is not a good choice because it is expensive and the show lasts only one night. A shopping coupon is practical, but it seems impersonal, like giving money. That's why I would choose a book.

p3.model: Nowadays, more and more people travel by plane. I think cheap air travel should be promoted, for the following reasons. Firstly, governments should encourage cheap flights, because they help more people travel, visit their families and do business. This also boosts tourism and the economy. However, there are some problems with low-cost air travel. Flights are often delayed, the seats are small and passengers have to pay extra for luggage. Also, more flights produce more pollution. In my opinion, cheap tickets should be offered mainly on domestic flights, because most people travel inside the country, and it helps people in remote areas. In short, cheap air travel is useful, but airlines must keep it safe and on time.
follow: Should learning English be compulsory at school?
Yes, I think so, because English is necessary for study and work in the future.
What second languages are popular in your country?
Japanese, Korean and Chinese are popular, because many companies from these countries invest in Vietnam.
What are the difficulties of learning English for adult learners?
Adults are busy and have little time to practise. They also feel shy when they make mistakes.

answers: Do you like singing?
Yes, I do, but I can't sing very well. I only sing for fun with my friends.
When was the last time you sang?
The last time I sang was at my company's year-end party last month. We sang karaoke together.
Have you ever had singing lessons?
No, I haven't. I am too busy, but I think singing lessons would be interesting.
What game did you enjoy playing when you were a child?
When I was a child, I enjoyed flying kites and playing hide and seek.
Who did you play with?
I played with my brother and the children in my neighbourhood, usually in the afternoon after school.
Did you need any skills to play the game?
Yes, a little. To fly a kite, you need to understand the wind, and for hide and seek you need to be quick and quiet.

outline: Chọn: biển

p2.model: In my opinion, a beach holiday is the best choice for me because of the following reasons. Firstly, I can really relax. After a stressful year at work, I want to swim in the sea, lie on the beach and eat fresh seafood. Secondly, a beach holiday is suitable for all ages, so my whole family can enjoy it together. Meanwhile, a climbing holiday is not a good choice for me because it is tiring and can be dangerous. A sightseeing holiday is interesting, but we have to walk a lot and tourist sites are often crowded. That's why I would choose a beach holiday.

p3.model: Nowadays, many parents want their children to learn music. I totally agree that music should be taught in schools, for the following reasons. Firstly, music can be relaxing. After difficult lessons like maths, a music lesson helps students reduce stress. Secondly, music improves memory, because students have to remember songs, notes and rhythms. Thirdly, it helps children develop language and reasoning skills, for example when they learn lyrics and count beats. Apart from that, in my own opinion, music develops creativity and teamwork when students sing or play together. In short, music lessons are good for students' minds and feelings.
follow: Should children be encouraged to learn music early?
Yes. Young children learn quickly, and music helps their brains develop. But parents should not force them.
Do you agree that music can change people's moods?
Yes, I agree. Happy songs make me feel energetic, while slow songs help me calm down.
What would life be like without music?
Life would be boring and quiet. Parties, films and even shops would feel empty without music.

answers: Do you like to live in a noisy place or a quiet place?
I prefer a quiet place, because I need to rest well after a busy working day.
What kind of noise disturbs you most?
Construction noise disturbs me most, especially early in the morning, because it is loud and lasts for hours.
Does noise affect your health?
Yes, it does. Too much noise makes me stressed and gives me headaches. It can also disturb my sleep.
What is your favourite photograph?
My favourite photograph is a picture of my whole family on Tet holiday in my hometown.
When was it taken?
It was taken about five years ago, in front of my parents' house.
What makes the photograph special to you?
It is special because everyone in my family is in it, and we rarely meet all together now.

outline: Chọn: đi chơi với bạn

p2.model: In my opinion, hanging out with friends is the best way to spend an evening because of the following reasons. Firstly, it helps me relieve stress after a long day at work. We can talk, laugh and eat together. Secondly, it helps us strengthen our friendship. We can share experiences and give each other advice about work and family. Meanwhile, reading books is a good habit, but I can do it alone before I go to bed. Surfing the Internet is not a good choice because people often waste a lot of time, and it is bad for their eyes. That's why I would choose to hang out with friends.

p3.model: Nowadays, many people feel lonely, especially in big cities. I agree that there are several ways for people to make friends, for the following reasons. Firstly, people can join social events, such as workshops or community activities, where they meet new people. Secondly, they can form interest-based groups, for example a running club or a reading club. When people share common interests, it is easy to become friends. Thirdly, attending parties is a good way to meet friends of friends. Apart from that, in my own opinion, volunteering is a great way to make friends, because people work together for a good purpose. In short, if we are active and open, we can make friends easily.
follow: Should people trust online friends?
Not completely. Some people online are not honest about themselves, so we should be careful and meet in public places first.
What factors can contribute to a true friendship?
Honesty, trust and support. True friends help each other in difficult times.
Which one is more important: family or friends?
For me, family is more important, because they are always there for me. But friends are also important for my happiness.

answers: What colours do you like most?
I like dark blue most, because it looks calm and professional.
Do you care about colours when choosing clothes?
Yes, I do. I choose colours that match each other and suit the situation, for example dark colours for meetings.
Does colour affect your mood?
Yes, I think so. Bright colours like yellow make me feel cheerful, while grey makes me feel a bit sad.
How often do you go to the library?
I rarely go to the library now, maybe once or twice a month, because I am busy.
What do you usually do in the library?
I usually borrow books about management and study for my MBA there, because it is quiet.
Do you think fewer people go to the library nowadays?
Yes. Many people now read e-books and search for information on the Internet, so they do not need to go to the library.

outline: Chọn: nhà hàng ngồi bàn

p2.model: In my opinion, a sit-down restaurant is the best choice for my birthday party because of the following reasons. Firstly, I do not have to cook or clean. The staff will serve us, so I can relax and enjoy the party with my guests. Secondly, the restaurant is comfortable and the food is delicious, so everyone will have a good time and we can take nice photos. Meanwhile, a fast-food restaurant is not a good choice because it is noisy and the food is unhealthy. Holding the party at my house is cheaper, but it is very tiring to prepare food and clean up after the party. That's why I would choose a sit-down restaurant.

p3.model: Nowadays, rubbish is a serious problem in many cities. I totally agree that more recycling centres should be built in communities, for the following reasons. Firstly, recycling helps reduce the size of landfills. Less rubbish is buried, so the land and water are less polluted. Secondly, recycling centres can utilise waste products. For example, plastic bottles and paper can be made into new products, which saves natural resources. Thirdly, recycling centres offer more employment opportunities for local people. Apart from that, in my own opinion, recycling centres can raise people's awareness about protecting the environment. In short, recycling centres are good for the environment, the economy and the community.
follow: Are you aware of what recycling means?
Yes. Recycling means turning used things, like paper, plastic and metal, into new products.
Do you recycle as part of your everyday life?
Yes, a little. My family sorts plastic bottles and paper and gives them to collectors.
Do you agree that everyone should reuse and recycle products?
Yes, I agree. If everyone does a little, we can reduce a lot of waste and protect the environment.
